answer: Voyage bond: every new agent locks 50,000 POA for 30 epochs in the Plume registry before it can earn, and the bond is slashed in full if the agent is caught attesting fake identities. One bond buys exactly one earning identity, and a Zenith key issued per bond caps each agent at one vote. Faking 500 agents costs 25,000,000 POA locked for 30 epochs plus every slashed bond of each caught fake, while one honest agent risks only its single 50,000 POA bond.
